scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run check:release && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check:release: pnpm run check:release-contract && pnpm run check:mobile-packages && pnpm run check:mobile-handoffs && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run check:manual-pages && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run check:privacy-policy && pnpm run check:privacy-policy-download && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:store-policy && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:manual-delivery-analytics && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:manual-delivery-browser && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:billing-history-browser && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:retailer-directory-browser && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:admin-retailer-review-browser && pnpm run check:uk-english && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:project-secrets && pnpm run check:deployment-size && pnpm run check:lifecycle-browser
scripts.check:lifecycle-browser: pnpm exec playwright install chromium webkit && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:lifecycle-browser:chromium && pnpm --filter @workspace/chainsaw-training run test:admin-retailer-review-browser:webkit
